description: Adapts an existing program for a user profile. Use when the user wants to customize a program (length, workouts per week, level). Returns the adapted program.

end_user_fitness_levels.description: Member's fitness level as a one-item list, e.g. ["intermediate"]. Values: beginner, intermediate, advanced.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

max_weeks.description: Longest adapted program in weeks, 1 to 52.

min_weeks.description: Shortest adapted program in weeks, 1 to 52.

plan_id.description: Program ID to adapt, from list_team_programs or recommend_plans.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

user_requirements.description: Free-text guidance for the AI, up to 2000 characters, e.g. "Low impact, no jumping, knee friendly".

workouts_per_week.description: Workouts per week in the adapted program, 1 to 7.

name: adapt_plan
title: Adapt plan
